description: Nomid staff only (Nomid system admins; refused for everyone else). Lists the reviews of portal AI chat conversations, newest first (default: FLAGGED in the last 7 days), each with its company, severity, signals, failure categories, the reviewer's summary and humanOffer (the "Talk to a human" offer the chat showed the user: SHOWN, ACCEPTED, DISMISSED or null). Pass a reviewId to read that review's conversation (a long one comes in parts: pass nextFromTurn as fromTurn): every turn's text, the tools the agent called with their status and input summary, proposals with their live outcome, and the user's feedback. Text is redacted (emails, company names, secrets); tool results are not stored, so they are not shown. Only reviews from the last 30 days.

fromTurn.description: With reviewId: the first turn to return (0-based). A long conversation comes in parts; pass the nextFromTurn of the previous call for the rest. Default 0.

limit.description: List only: at most this many reviews, newest first. Default 25.

offset.description: List only: skip this many matching reviews (newest first). Pass the nextOffset of the previous call for the next ones. Default 0.

reviewId.description: Optional. A reviewId from the list: returns that review's redacted conversation instead of the list.

since.description: List only: ISO-8601 instant; reviews made at or after it. Default 7 days ago, never more than 30 days back.

status.description: List only: the review verdict to list. Default FLAGGED.

name: read_flagged_chats
title: Read flagged AI chats (Nomid staff)
